audit_comment: APPENDIX 3: THE CLERICAL QUICK-REFERENCE CHARTS, BATCH THREE - the D&DG walk round twenty-three, print pp. 138-139: the third batch of deity rows - Egyptian (17), Finnish (11) - riding the roster data file, the Egyptian block below the R870 Cthulhu tail on pdf 138; the App 3 gap box stays open until the last chart batch lands. The print voice is the ROTATED tesseract pass, collated against the 1eonline L&L per-deity chart rows. The headline divergence: the L&L Seker row duplicates Shu - the print reads the distinct Seker row (feathered helm, white tunic, white, summer solstice, annually, jewelry) - pinned by print, eyeball flag.

banner.title: Appendix 3: the clerical quick-reference chart, batch three - the D&DG walk round twenty-three, print pp. 138-139: the 28 rows of the Egyptian and Finnish pantheons across the 13 printed columns.
banner.provenance: primary ink: the ROTATED extract/ddg tesseract pass (pNNN_rot_full.txt + pNNN_rot_tsv.tsv, pdf pages 138-139; the second printing) - the Egyptian block sits below the R870 Cthulhu tail on pdf 138, the Finnish block spans the pdf 138 tail and the pdf 139 head; the collation voice: the 1eonline L&L per-deity chart rows. The adjudications: the Seker row (the L&L voice duplicates Shu - the print row pinned, eyeball flag), the empty L&L sphere cells (Geb earth, Set evil - the print pinned), the Isis magic spelling (the L&L magick <(The Occult)> gloss a 5th-print addition), the Ilmatar single-X geometry seated in the F column by the TSV (female-only, both voices agree), the Bes Ie;:nher garble restored to leather vest, kilt, the Ukko chain mail pinned over the L&L chian typo, and the Mielikki lowercase nature pinned. The batch order runs Egyptian, Finnish.
